name: Ungodly: Greek Gods on Campus
source:
You’re the new arrival at GOD U, a campus packed with Greek gods. When a murder shakes things up, what else can a new god do but solve it… with kisses?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你是GOD U的新来者，这是一个充满希腊诸神的校园。当谋杀案搅动一切时，新神除了用亲吻解决问题还能做什么？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
